audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Kennen, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kennen, Kayle, Kayle — Kayle winning Levels 3 and 4-5 while the whys underneath them say Kennen bursts her at three marks and that 4-5 are even.
audit.why: Kayle is melee with no dash until her level-11 ranged form; the packet levelChart and the audited mirror (kayle__kennen) both give Kennen rows 1-2 and Skill on rows 3-5, with Kayle owning only 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped as matched pairs to Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Skill, Skill in both layers. Row 0 (Kennen) and row 6 (Kayle) already agreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] said 'Without your R yet this is a chip-and-respect window' on the Level 6 row — Slicing Maelstrom is exactly what you get at 6. No cooldown numbers appeared anywhere (packet: zero sequencing cues).
audit.why: Kennen R is a flat 120s at 550 range; Kayle R is 160/120/80s at 900 range. At 6 the pair is 120s of AoE stun against 160s of invulnerability, which is why the row is Skill and not a free kill.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rows rewritten with both cooldowns; 160s and 120s written into phases[4].why, whys[4], breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: late and wants.foe[2] claim Divine Judgment 'eats your entire stun-lock' / 'negates' it, and late calls Slicing Maelstrom a channel Kayle can press R on.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Kayle makes an ally invulnerable' — that is damage invulnerability. It does not remove Mark of the Storm or the stun, and Kennen's R carries no channel flag. What actually happens is that the storm keeps ticking on a target taking zero.
audit.corrected: Both claims restated as: she takes zero from the storm while it runs, so bait the 160s ult before you spend the 120s one. The CC claim is removed, not reversed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Starfire Spellblade's auto-attack reset is never mentioned.
audit.why: It is a 8/7.5/7/6.5/6-second auto reset, so her burst opens with an attack wind-up rather than a visible cast.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns as the burst tell.

audit.why: Celestial Blessing (15s flat) heals her through chip, and report[8].t already prescribes Oblivion Orb / Executioner's early.
audit.corrected: No change needed; the anti-heal line is present and correctly timed. Added a nod to the 15s heal in the Levels 4-5 row so the player knows why the chip vanishes.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Kayle contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Kayle is melee until her level-11 ranged form and has no escape — Thundering Shuriken chips her free from 950 range.

edits.before: Mark management: third proc stuns — count to three. Only take the trade when Kayle's Divine Judgment is down.
edits.after: Every ability adds a Mark of the Storm and the third stuns — she has no dash, so two marks means she is caught.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kayle must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit: Q-W-E is three marks and a stun on a Kayle who can only farm with Starfire Spellblade. Deny her the CS.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Divine Judgment's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: She farms under tower with Starfire Spellblade and soaks XP, and a 15-second Celestial Blessing heals your chip back. Deny the plates.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom + Zhonya wins any grouped fight top-side. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kayle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is a 120-second all-in; Divine Judgment is 160 seconds of invulnerability that takes zero from it. Bait it first.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Divine Judgment's cooldown.
edits.after: Your Liandry's burst can still kill her, but her first item and her ult are up — commit only once R is spent.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Kayle carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Her level-11 ranged form autos you from outside Q range and Divine Judgment blanks your burst. Stop duelling, group.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1 — invulnerability, not CC immunity, so the storm keeps running on a target taking zero. - Starfire Spellblade: a 6-8s auto-attack reset; the wind-up is her burst tell. - Your R: a flat 120s.

edits.before: Without your R yet this is a chip-and-respect window, and she is just grinding toward her two-item ranged power, so trades stay neutral.
edits.after: At 6 we both spike — my Slicing Maelstrom on 120s against Divine Judgment on 160s, an invulnerability that eats the whole storm.

edits.before: Kayle's level-11 ranged-form upgrade plus her R invuln turns the duel — she kites your short body and presses R through your stun window.
edits.after: Kayle's level-11 ranged form plus a 120-second Divine Judgment turns the duel — she kites you out of Q range and your burst lands for zero.

edits.before: Save her R invulnerability to negate your Slicing Maelstrom stun-lock and all-in
edits.after: Save Divine Judgment so your Slicing Maelstrom burst lands on an invulnerable target

edits.before: Once Kayle hits two items and her level-11 ranged-form upgrade, the lane flips hard. She auto-attacks you from outside Q range, her E gives ranged waveclear, and her R invulnerability eats your entire stun-lock if she presses it on your R channel. Your squishy caster body can't duel a fed scaler — so close the game on your 6/first-item spike, pivot to teamfighting where your AoE R peels and engages, and let your team handle her side lane. Do not 1v1 her after she scales.
edits.after: Once Kayle hits two items and her level-11 ranged-form upgrade, the lane flips hard. She auto-attacks you from outside Q range, Starfire Spellblade gives ranged waveclear, and Divine Judgment makes her invulnerable for the whole storm, so your 120-second ult lands for zero. Your squishy caster body can't duel a fed scaler — close on your 6/first-item spike, pivot to teamfights where your AoE peels and engages, and let your team handle her side lane. Do not 1v1 her after she scales.

notes: Packet defect 'never names any of Kayle's abilities' is now partly fixed: Starfire Spellblade and Celestial Blessing are named in the rewritten rows, Divine Judgment was already named throughout. Packet also reported zero sequencing cues — the 160s-vs-120s ult trade is now stated in three places. Level 6 is Skill, not Kennen, per the mirror: Kennen gets the AoE stun but Kayle gets an invulnerability with a longer cooldown, and the row must not contradict kayle__kennen. Ratings left alone (mirror did not report its rating row).
